# NFT Alpha Scanner

An ERC-8257 OpenSea Agent Tool that evaluates an NFT collection using observable marketplace signals.

Tool endpoint: /api
Manifest: /.well-known/ai-tool/nft-alpha-scanner.json

Input:
- collectionSlug: OpenSea collection slug
- maxPriceEth: optional ETH budget for floor-price fit

Output includes a heuristic signal (BUY/WATCH/AVOID), score, confidence, floor momentum, volume momentum, recent sales, holder count, reasons, and risks.
